title: 2844. Minimum Operations to Make a Special Number

examples.explanation: Delete digits num[5] and num[6]. The resulting number is "22450" which is special since it is divisible by 25. It can be shown that 2 is the minimum number of operations required to get a special number.

Delete digits num[3], num[4], and num[6]. The resulting number is "2900" which is special since it is divisible by 25. It can be shown that 3 is the minimum number of operations required to get a special number.
Delete digit num[0]. The resulting number is "0" which is special since it is divisible by 25. It can be shown that 1 is the minimum number of operations required to get a special number.

A number is divisible by 25 if its last two digits are 75, 50, 25, or 00.
Iterate over all possible pairs of indices i < j such that num[i] * 10 + num[j] is in [00,25,50,75]. Then, set the answer to min(answer, n - i - 2) .
